description: Expeditors International of Washington, Inc. provides a full suite of global logistics services, offering customers access to an international network of people and integrated information systems to support the movement and strategic positioning of goods. As a third-party logistics provider it purchases cargo space from carriers such as airlines, ocean shipping lines and trucking lines on a volume basis and resells that space to its customers, and it does not compete for overnight courier or small parcel business and does not own aircraft or ships. It provides a broad range of transportation services and customer solutions such as customs brokerage, order management, time-definite transportation, warehousing and distribution, temperature-controlled transit, cargo insurance, specialized cargo monitoring and tracking, and other customized logistics and consulting solutions, and its Project Cargo unit handles special project shipments that move via a single method or combination of air, ocean and ground transportation.
